[b][color=#ffaa00]Objective[/color][/b]

Recreate, as closely as possible, the nail art shown on the right hand. Apply the design to the left hand mirrored to maintain symmetry. Each of the 5 levels requires a score of at least [b][color=#ffaa00]@@@[/color][/b] to pass.

[b][color=#ffaa00]How to play[/color][/b]

- Use the top bar to select a nail polish color [icon=polish].
- Use the buttons on the left to choose stickers [icon=sticker].
- Use the slider on the right to adjust the brush or sticker size [icon=plus].

Keep an eye on the timer! If it runs out, your work will be automatically compared to the reference nails. If you finish early, press [icon=ready] to submit your design.

[b][color=#ffaa00]Free Play[/color][/b]

After completing all levels, you’ll be able to design nails freely with no time limit.

[b][color=#ffaa00]### anywhere[/color][/b] to begin.
